label: Shader gradient
desc: A flowing mesh-gradient background drawn by a fragment shader (domain-warped noise) in the brand colours; the pointer gently bends it.
use: Behind a landing hero or sign-in panel (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Shader waves
desc: A calm water surface from a layered sine height field with fake lighting; pointer movement and clicks send rings across it.
use: Behind a landing hero, footer or empty state (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Particle sphere
desc: A rotating sphere of about 2500 depth-sized, depth-faded points; drag to rotate with inertia, arrow keys rotate, Home resets.
use: Landing hero visual or connect page centrepiece (fills its parent; sphere fits the smaller side).

label: Wire terrain
desc: An endless scrolling wireframe terrain in perspective with a horizon fade; mouse X steers the camera slightly.
use: Behind a landing hero or 404 page (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Plasma orb
desc: A glowing shader orb with a swirling plasma surface and soft rim light; the pointer tilts its light.
use: Hero accent, loading or AI-assistant visual (centred in its parent, which it fills).
